description: The SSH agent wire-protocol sign-only filter's conformance table — every known SSH_AGENTC_* request type mapped to its allow/block decision. Generated, not hand-maintained; do not edit this file directly, edit src/services/ssh-agent-filter.ts and regenerate (npm run generate:ssh-agent-filter-vectors).

edgeCases.name: zero-length-body
edgeCases.description: A frame with body length 0 (no type byte to classify) is BLOCKED, not thrown — treated as fully-parsed, bounded input, the same as any other frame absent from the allowlist. Only an untrustworthy LENGTH prefix (see oversized-declared-length below) is fatal.

edgeCases.name: oversized-declared-length
edgeCases.description: A declared body length exceeding maxFrameBytes is FATAL — throw / tear down the connection, not silently block or cap. The length prefix itself can't be trusted at that point, so it's not safe to keep parsing the stream at all.

edgeCases.name: allowed-frames-forwarded-unmodified
edgeCases.description: An allowed frame is forwarded byte-for-byte to the real agent socket, including its own length prefix — never re-encoded, re-framed, or otherwise touched.

edgeCases.name: rejected-length-tracking
edgeCases.description: Each blocked frame's ORIGINAL byte length (length prefix + body) must be tracked separately from the synthesized failure reply's own fixed 5-byte size — a relay acknowledging flow-control credit for the request needs the real size, not the reply's.
